read_anchor.plan_title: # Codex red-team — local experimental port with observable verification

evidence: The opened plan and repository HEAD matched the declared fingerprint. In fresh in-memory CLI inputs, the canonical gate returned CLEARED with expected=1 and onTarget=1 when read_anchor used the exact path/title but plan_sha256 was 64 f characters and target_revision was 40 zeroes. The exact-identity control also returned CLEARED. Changing only the title returned INCOMPLETE with onTarget=0. Source inspection explains the result: isOnTarget() checks only normalized plan_title and whether resolved_path is absolute and under repo; the FINDINGS schema requires only resolved_path and plan_title. Neither validates the per-result plan hash or repository revision against the run fingerprint.
note: The candidate finding is independently reproduced without repository mutation or external state. The stale-identity result was generated from a new in-memory input, and the exact-identity and wrong-title controls rule out malformed coverage accounting or a probe-created setup artifact. The plan requires recorded plan/hash/revision identities and visible off-target evidence, but does not explicitly require the reusable gate to bind each probe attestation to the hash and revision.
